newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Air Canada to seek flights to Kiev.
newsitem.headline: Air Canada to seek flights to Kiev.

text.p: Air Canada has won its country's service rights for Ukraine, and Ottawa will start talks with Kiev for flights to start to the former Soviet republic, the Canadian foreign ministry said on Thursday.
Air Canada will seek to operate a daily code-share through one of its European gateways, the ministry said in a statement during a visit by Foreign Minister Lloyd Axworthy to Ukraine.
The statement said Air Canada would have one year from now or six months from the day the government struck a deal with Kiev -- whichever came later -- to implement the decision.
Several carriers already operate flights between the two countries.
